title: Faith For Others
verse: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.
observation: Can you imagine how embarrassing it was to be lowered down in front of everyone? Then, how much he probably didn't care once he was healed. Great things take great courage and trust in God.
application: What would I do for God if I had the courage to trust Him?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for dealing with our heart issues and healing us so we can be bold.
